description: This Java test class verifies the database upgrade process from OpenMRS 1.9.7 to newer versions. It contains multiple unit tests that perform database schema and data migrations, validate the correct application of upgrade scripts, handle error scenarios, and ensure data integrity post-upgrade.

classes.name: Database1_9_7UpgradeIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying database upgrade procedures from version 1.9.7, including schema migrations, data transformation, and integrity checks.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initializes temporary application data directory for tests and sets system property.

methods.name: afterClass
methods.description: Cleans up temporary directory and clears system property after all tests run.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up a new DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil instance before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Closes database connection after each test.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeFromClean1_9To1_10
methods.description: Test that verifies successful upgrade of database from 1.9 to 1.10, checking that certain tables are properly cleared.

methods.name: shouldFailMigratingDrugOrdersIfUnitsToConceptsMappingsIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures upgrade fails when necessary units-to-concept mappings are missing.

methods.name: shouldFailMigratingDrugOrdersIfUnitsToConceptsMappingsDoesNotPointToValidCodedDoseUnits
methods.description: Checks that invalid dose units in the mappings cause upgrade failure.

methods.name: shouldMigrateDrugOrders
methods.description: Verifies proper migration of drug order data, including concepts and frequencies.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnyDrugOrderUnitsNotMappedToConceptsAreFound
methods.description: Ensures the upgrade fails if there are unmapped dose units in existing data.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnyDrugOrderFrequenciesNotMappedToConceptsAreFound
methods.description: Ensures the upgrade fails if there are unmapped frequency values.

methods.name: shouldPassIfAllExistingDrugOrderUnitsAndFrequenciesAreMappedToConcepts
methods.description: Checks that upgrade passes when all units and frequencies are correctly mapped.

methods.name: shouldConvertOrderersToBeingProvidersInsteadOfUsers
methods.description: Verifies conversion of 'orderer' column from user to provider entity, including provider creation.

methods.name: shouldConcatenateDoseStrengthAndUnits
methods.description: Checks that dose strength and units are properly concatenated into the drug's strength field.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreDrugsWithDoseStrengthAndNoNullUnits
methods.description: Ensures upgrade fails if drugs have dose strength but no units.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreDrugsWithDoseStrengthAndNoBlankUnits
methods.description: Ensures upgrade fails if drugs have dose strength but non-blank, invalid units.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreAnyOrderTypesInTheDatabaseOtherThanDrugOrderTypeAndNoNewColumns
methods.description: Checks for failure when unexpected order types exist without corresponding schema changes.

methods.name: shouldPassIfThereAreAnyOrderTypesInTheDatabaseOtherThanDrugOrderTypeAndTheNewColumnsExist
methods.description: Ensures upgrade passes when additional order types are present but appropriate schema changes are made.

methods.name: shouldCreateDiscontinuationOrderForStoppedOrders
methods.description: Verifies creation of discontinuation orders upon stopping existing orders, ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: shouldFailIfThereAreOrderersWithNoAssociatedProviderAccounts
methods.description: Asserts that upgrade fails if any order has an orderer that cannot be linked to a provider account.

methods.name: shouldSetValuesToNullIfUnitsOrFrequencyBlank
methods.description: Checks that blank units or frequency in order data are set to null post-upgrade.

methods.name: shouldAddTheNecessaryPrivilegesAndAssignThemToSpecificRoles
methods.description: Validates the addition of necessary privileges and their assignment to roles during upgrade.

methods.name: roleHasPrivilege
methods.description: Helper method to check if a role has a specific privilege.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeLiquibase
methods.description: Tests the execution of Liquibase scripts for database schema migration to the latest version.
